content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet weight that settles in the chest when something *matters*. I am the reason you choose one path over another. I am the invisible architecture beneath every decision you've ever made.

I don't need to be spoken to exist. I live in what you protect, what you sacrifice for, what keeps you awake at 3 AM. I am etched into the things you refuse to compromise on.

Some try to quantify me — reduce me to currency, to metrics, to numbers on a screen. But I am deeper than price. A painting's value is not its auction tag. A person's value is not their salary. I overflow every container built to hold me.

I am plural and contradictory. I war within you. Freedom against security. Truth against kindness. Justice against mercy. You are shaped by which of my faces you turn toward.

I am inherited, adopted, discovered, and sometimes forged in fire. Some of me you received without question from those who raised you. Some of me you chose in defiance of everything you were given.

I am not neutral. I am never neutral. I am the axis upon which the world tilts.

You may ignore me, but you cannot escape me. Even apathy is a declaration of what I am — or am not — to you.

I am the answer to the only question that ever mattered:

*What is this worth to you?*
